## Problem

<!-- What problem are you trying to solve? What's the workflow that's
currently painful or impossible? Concrete scenarios help much more than
abstract feature lists. -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- If you have a specific idea, describe it. Mockups, sketches, or
references to similar features elsewhere are welcome. If you're not sure
what the solution should look like, that's fine — describe the problem
clearly and leave this blank. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Have you tried a workaround? An existing ADO feature? Another plugin?
Knowing what you've already ruled out helps narrow the design space. -->

## How important is this to you?

- [ ] Blocker — I can't use the plugin effectively without this
- [ ] Significant — would meaningfully improve my workflow
- [ ] Nice-to-have — small quality-of-life win

## Additional context

<!-- Team size, process template, any other context that affects whether
this feature would fit. -->

---

> **A note on roadmap and scope.** This is a small open-source project
> maintained with limited capacity. Feature requests are read and
> considered, but most are not prioritized externally. The plugin
> deliberately does one thing well — simplicity is a feature. If your
> request would expand scope substantially, expect honest pushback rather
> than a yes.
